# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(forcats)
```

# 2. Load data
```{r}
base_dir <- "/Users/karenshih/Documents/research/scg/protein-master/v2_pancan_batch_corrected"
data_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "analysis/04_enrichment/ora")
df <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "kegg_ora_tmb_up.csv"))
```

# 3. Clean + prepare data
```{r}
df_clean <- df %>%
  filter(category != "Human Diseases") %>%
  filter(!subcategory %in% c(
    "Global and overview maps",
    "Transport and catabolism",
    "Endocrine system"
  )) %>%
  filter(!Description %in% c(
    "Oocyte meiosis",
    "Progesterone-mediated oocyte maturation"
  ))
```

```{r}
unique(df_clean$subcategory)
```


```{r}
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      # 🔥 PQC
      # subcategory == "Folding, sorting and degradation" ~ "Protein quality control (PQC)",
      
      # 🧬 DNA
      subcategory == "Replication and repair" ~ "DNA replication and repair",
      
      # ⚡ All metabolism collapsed
      subcategory %in% c(
        "Energy metabolism",
        "Carbohydrate metabolism",
        "Metabolism of terpenoids and polyketides",
        "Glycan biosynthesis and metabolism",
        "Amino acid metabolism"
      ) ~ "Metabolism",
      
      # 🛡️ Immune
      subcategory == "Immune system" ~ "Immune",
      
      # everything else stays the same
      TRUE ~ subcategory
    )
  )
```

# 5. Order + palette
```{r}
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c(
      # "Protein quality control (PQC)",
      "Folding, sorting and degradation",
      "Translation",
      "Transcription",
      "DNA replication and repair",
      "Cell growth and death",
      "Metabolism",
      "Immune"
    ))
  )
```

```{r}
category_order <- c(
  # "Protein quality control (PQC)",
  "Folding, sorting and degradation",
  "Translation",
  "Transcription",
  "DNA replication and repair",
  "Cell growth and death",
  "Metabolism",
  "Immune",
  "Other"
)
```


```{r}
palette <- c(
  "Folding, sorting and degradation" = "#D55E00",  # vermillion (PQC - highlight)
  "Translation"                      = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "Transcription"                    = "#009E73",  # teal
  "DNA replication and repair"       = "#984ea3",  # purple (keeping yours)
  "Cell growth and death"            = "#CC79A7",  # mauve
  "Metabolism"                       = "#E69F00",  # amber
  "Immune"                           = "#56B4E9",  # sky blue
  "Other"                            = "#999999"   # mid gray
)

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = category_order),
    Description = fct_reorder(Description, neglogP)
  )
```

```{r}
fout = file.path(base_dir, "results/tables/tableS1/full_kegg_enrichment_results_for_tmb_associated_genes.csv")
# write.csv(df, fout,row.names = FALSE)
```


# 6. Plot by functional category
```{r}
p_category <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = neglogP, y = Description, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray40",
             size = 0.6) +

  labs(
    x = "-log10(FDR)",
    y = NULL,
    # title = "KEGG Pathway Enrichment\nAll TMB-Associated Genes",
   # subtitle = "Colored by functional category; dashed line indicates FDR = 0.05"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.05, "lines")
  )
```

```{r}
fout = file.path(base_dir, "results/figures/main/fig1/fig1b_kegg_ora_by_function_all_tmb_genes.pdf")
ggsave(fout, p_category, width = 7, height = 9, device = cairo_pdf, dpi = 300)
```

# 6c. Vertical stack, descriptions on y-axis, tighter bars
```{r}
p_category_tight <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = neglogP, y = Description, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.95) +

  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = palette, name = "Functional category") +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray40",
             size = 0.6) +

  labs(
    x = "-log10(FDR)",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.02, "lines")
  )
```

```{r}
fout = file.path(base_dir, "results/figures/main/fig1/fig1b_kegg_ora_by_function_all_tmb_genes_tight.pdf")
ggsave(fout, p_category_tight, width = 7, height = 9, device = cairo_pdf, dpi = 300)
```

# 6b. Horizontal layout (facets side-by-side, vertical bars)
```{r}
p_category_h <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = Description, y = neglogP, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  facet_grid(. ~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = palette, name = "Functional category") +

  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray40",
             size = 0.6) +

  labs(
    y = "-log10(FDR)",
    x = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines")
  ) +

  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1))
```

```{r}
fout = file.path(base_dir, "results/figures/main/fig1/fig1b_kegg_ora_by_function_all_tmb_genes_horizontal.pdf")
ggsave(fout, p_category_h + theme(legend.position = "none"), width = 16, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(cowplot)

legend_only <- get_legend(p_category_h)
p_legend <- plot_grid(legend_only)

fout_legend = file.path(base_dir, "results/figures/main/fig1/fig1b_kegg_ora_by_function_all_tmb_genes_horizontal_legend.pdf")
ggsave(fout_legend, p_legend, width = 9, height = 2.5, device = cairo_pdf, dpi = 300)
```

# 7. Plot by PQC vs non-PQC
```{r}
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    highlight = ifelse(
      group == "Protein quality control (PQC)",
      "PQC",
      "Other"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
p_pqc <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = neglogP, y = Description, fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    'PQC' = '#D55E00',   # highlight PQC
    'Other' = '#999999'
  )) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray40",
             size = 0.6) +

  labs(
    x = "-log10(FDR)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "KEGG Pathway Enrichment\nAll TMB-Associated Genes",
    subtitle = "PQC pathways highlighted; dashed line indicates FDR = 0.05"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines")
  )
```

```{r}
fout = file.path(base_dir, "results/figures/main/fig1/kegg_ora_by_pqc_all_tmb_genes.pdf")
ggsave(fout, p_pqc, width = 7, height = 9, device = cairo_pdf, dpi = 300)
```
